<description>
Closes #27583.

`PSBT_GLOBAL_XPUB` already serializes, deserializes and merges when PSBTs are combined. Nothing writes it, so a PSBT produced by the wallet never carries it, and a signer that only has the file cannot rebuild the multisig from it. Today Specter [fills the field itself](https://github.com/cryptoadvance/specter-desktop/blob/8843e2f0640a9adc129f9ab6afe5ecb9632e7c5b/src/cryptoadvance/specter/wallet/wallet.py#L1866-L1881) after getting the PSBT from Core.

Before and after with the BitBox02 and Trezor simulators

A 2-of-3 `wsh(sortedmulti(...))` on regtest with the simulator as one co-signer, signed through HWI 3.2.0. The "before" file is the same PSBT with its `PSBT_GLOBAL_XPUB` records removed, so nothing else differs.

| | without the field | with the field |
|---|---|---|
| BitBox02 | refuses, `This BitBox02 is not one of the cosigners` | signs |
| Trezor T | signs, co-signer nodes sent with zeroed chain codes and no derivation paths | signs, nodes sent with the real chain codes and paths |

What `parse_multisig` hands the Trezor for the change output:

```
without: global xpubs=0  zeroed chain codes=3/3  depths=[0, 0, 0]  paths=[[], [], []]
with   : global xpubs=3  zeroed chain codes=0/3  depths=[4, 4, 4]  paths=[[1, 0], [1, 0], [1, 0]]
```

A new `Descriptor` accessor returns the extended keys a descriptor is built from, and `DescriptorScriptPubKeyMan::FillPSBT` writes those of every descriptor with an input or an output in the PSBT. That covers `walletcreatefundedpsbt`, `walletprocesspsbt`, `send`, `sendall`, `psbtbumpfee` and the GUI send dialog, which all go through `CWallet::FillPSBT`.

Only the keys BIP 174 allows are added, the ones that derive, through unhardened steps alone, a key the PSBT gives a derivation path for. So a key expression ending in `/*h` adds nothing.

Whoever holds a PSBT from the wallet can now derive the addresses of the descriptors it uses. Setting `bip32derivs` to false in `walletcreatefundedpsbt` or `walletprocesspsbt` leaves the field out, along with the derivation paths.

`descriptorprocesspsbt` is left out, since it signs from the descriptors it is given without going through the wallet, and I intend to cover it as a follow-up.
</description>

[2026-11-01] r:5729543852 review COMMENTED by fametrano (edited 2026-11-01):
Concept ACK

One issue should be fixed before merge: a watch-only wallet holding one xpub under two origins now gets a PSBT that `decodepsbt` refuses. With `wpkh([A/84h/1h/0h]xpub/0/*)` and `wpkh([00000000/84h/1h/0h]xpub/1/*)`, `walletcreatefundedpsbt` and `send`, which has no `bip32derivs` to turn it off, both report success and return it. No funds are at risk, but the error only shows when the next tool reads the file. This is the first of Ralph's two Minors; both reproduce at 437936e5 without an edited file.

The suggestion in `AddGlobalXpubs` keeps the origin already present, as `MergeGlobalXPubs` does since #35665. With all the suggestions, both reproductions exit 0, and the affected unit tests and eight functional tests pass; each regression test fails without its fix. Scripts and output: https://gist.github.com/fametrano/1cb22c31d89e06cd722dadaec3dc7230/b7f27effa3b47cd36468d9ae24407e71cf9970ee

Not blocking: the root exclusion falls to two RPCs. A sender calls `descriptorprocesspsbt` with `wpkh([root origin]key)` on a stranger's key, then a `/*h` wallet that the PSBT pays adds its root in `walletprocesspsbt`. That root derives no key of the wallet's descriptor, so no address is exposed, but the description says `/*h` adds nothing. The other two suggestions derive the key instead of comparing its path, and test it.
[2026-11-01] rc:4436804277 inline on src/wallet/scriptpubkeyman.cpp by fametrano (edited 2026-11-01):
Not blocking: a path in the PSBT is only a claim, so this derives the key and compares it. It keeps the hardened check, since `CPubKey::Derive` asserts on a hardened step, and the regression test is the suggestion in the functional test. Only entries at this origin cost a derivation, and a PSBT's real key stops the search; a hostile 2 MB file of 510,000 steps took 6 to 7 s in `walletprocesspsbt` here, against 0.06 s on the head.

```suggestion
//! Whether one of these keys, at this origin, derives a key the PSBT gives a derivation
//! path for, through unhardened steps alone. The key is derived rather than its path
//! compared, since a path in the PSBT says whatever its sender wrote.
static bool DerivesKeyInPSBT(const PartiallySignedTransaction& psbtx, const KeyOriginInfo& origin, const std::set<CExtPubKey>& keys)
{
    const auto derives{[&](const XOnlyPubKey& pubkey, const KeyOriginInfo& info) {
        if (info.fingerprint != origin.fingerprint || info.path.size() < origin.path.size()) return false;
        const auto rest{info.path.begin() + origin.path.size()};
        if (!std::equal(info.path.begin(), rest, origin.path.begin()) ||
            std::any_of(rest, info.path.end(), [](uint32_t step) { return (step & BIP32_HARDENED_FLAG) != 0; })) return false;
        return std::ranges::any_of(keys, [&](CExtPubKey key) {
            for (auto step{rest}; step != info.path.end(); ++step) {
                CExtPubKey child;
                if (!key.Derive(child, *step)) return false;
                key = child;
            }
            return XOnlyPubKey{key.pubkey} == pubkey;
        });
    }};
    const auto lists_derived_key{[&](const auto& in_or_out) {
        return std::ranges::any_of(in_or_out.hd_keypaths, [&](const auto& entry) { return derives(XOnlyPubKey{entry.first}, entry.second); }) ||
               std::ranges::any_of(in_or_out.m_tap_bip32_paths, [&](const auto& entry) { return derives(entry.first, entry.second.second); });
    }};
    return std::ranges::any_of(psbtx.inputs, lists_derived_key) || std::ranges::any_of(psbtx.outputs, lists_derived_key);
}

void DescriptorScriptPubKeyMan::AddGlobalXpubs(PartiallySignedTransaction& psbtx) const
{
    LOCK(cs_desc_man);
    std::map<KeyOriginInfo, std::set<CExtPubKey>> xpubs{
        m_wallet_descriptor.descriptor->GetExtPubKeysWithOrigins(&m_wallet_descriptor.cache)};

    // BIP 174 wants the keys that the transaction's keys derive from, each with as many
    // steps in its path as its depth. Where the cache lacks the key at the last hardened
    // step, the descriptor hands out its root instead, and a root with hardened steps still
    // below it derives none of them; a key written without its origin has a path too short
    // for its depth. Neither can go in.
    std::erase_if(xpubs, [&](const auto& entry) {
        const auto& [origin, keys]{entry};
        return !DerivesKeyInPSBT(psbtx, origin, keys) ||
```
[2026-11-01] rc:4436804287 inline on src/wallet/scriptpubkeyman.cpp by fametrano (edited 2026-11-01):
`walletcreatefundedpsbt` and `send` both returned a PSBT `decodepsbt` refuses, in a wallet holding one xpub under two origins. `MergeGlobalXPubs` already keeps the first origin it sees (#35665), so this uses it. With this they decode, with one record, and the PR's tests still pass. In that wallet the origin that stays follows the pointer order of `GetAllScriptPubKeyMans`, so it can change across a restart.

```suggestion
    PartiallySignedTransaction candidates{CMutableTransaction{}};
    candidates.m_xpubs = std::move(xpubs);
    psbtx.MergeGlobalXPubs(candidates);
```
